executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $162.85 per resident day (42.6% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -12.3% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $913,048, 12.6% of the $7,266,717 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,210,365, $27.12 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $1,210,365 (100.0%). Most food spending was a purchased (contracted) service ($1,196,562), so raw food per resident day is not comparable with homes that buy their own food.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $786,475, $17.63 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $786,475 (100.0%).
Direct care cost per resident day went from $107.42 (cost year 2016) to $162.85 (cost year 2025); over the same years the Connecticut median went from $123.75 to $174.45.

Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); Cost year 2025 laundry is not used: missing.; Cost year 2025 raw food is not used: not comparable (food bought by a contractor, lines do not add up, or missing).; Cost year 2025: no laundry costs were read from the report.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
